task.description:
Implement the backend (Zig) portion of SPC-01 and SPC-02 (WF-02 Batch B).

BRANCH: feature/WF02-plc-batch-b-20260815

DESIGN: src/design/spc-01-sub-process-interface-contract.md (commit 3a173a5d, PASSED Step 01b gate)

REQUIREMENTS:
- SPC-01: Declared input/output contract for SUB_PROCESS nodes (filtered variable copy-in on activation, filtered merge-back on completion, EE-10 error transitions for missing/invalid inputs and missing required outputs; EXT-05 backward-compatible when interface omitted)
- SPC-02: Definition-time validation — every json_schema under inputs/outputs must be a well-formed JSON Schema, else HTTP 422

BACKEND SCOPE (per design §Public interface + §Runtime semantics + §SPC-02):
1. Create src/definition/sub_process_interface.zig — the `interface` object data model (inputs/outputs: {name, json_schema, required}), parse + validate helpers
2. Runtime: filtered copy-in of named+valid inputs into child initial variable map on SUB_PROCESS activation; filtered merge-back of named outputs on child completion (EE-09); empty-inputs -> empty map; no-interface -> EXT-05 unchanged
3. EE-10 error transitions: SUB_PROCESS_MISSING_REQUIRED_INPUT, SUB_PROCESS_INPUT_SCHEMA_VIOLATION, SUB_PROCESS_MISSING_REQUIRED_OUTPUT, SUB_PROCESS_OUTPUT_SCHEMA_VIOLATION (with atomicity / no-orphan-child)
4. Definition-time validation hook in checkSubProcess (PD-05, after PD-02) using src/tools/json_schema.zig well-formedness rule; HTTP 422 with node + offending schema identification
5. If a migration is needed (e.g. persisting interface attributes on definition nodes), add it following migration scope rules

Verify: zig build compiles; zig build test passes for affected unit tests.
